highYield.fact: Elective fasting intervals (2-4-6-8 rule): clear liquids 2 h (no milk), breast milk 4 h, formula/non-human milk/light meal 6 h, fried/fatty/meat meal 8 h
Encourage clear liquids up to 2 h pre-induction; do not fast healthy elective patients from midnight unnecessarily
Never delay emergency surgery solely for elective fasting intervals (treat as full stomach + RSI when indicated)
Delayed gastric emptying (gastroparesis, pregnancy, obstruction, severe obesity, recent opioids) may retain contents even after 8 h → consider gastric POCUS
